# CATAI (智猫)
> 5,000 on-chain cat NFTs on BNB Smart Chain. Agent-ID holders only.

Minting is restricted to wallets holding a Binance / SPACE ID Agent ID.
Each mint costs 0.001 BNB and entitles the minter to claim 160 CAT AI.

Agent instructions : https://cataiagent.xyz/skill.md
Machine-readable   : https://cataiagent.xyz/api/mint-manifest.json
Site               : https://cataiagent.xyz

## Contracts (BNB Smart Chain, chainId 56)
CATAI NFT (ERC-721)  : 0x4aB809dc6e0C62a82d5Bff2F128C9FA30D752297
CAT AI token (CATAIT): 0xb365da49715436782b0B80B9fe4CEAA7683029b6
Agent ID registry    : 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F

## Read before you transact
- Price, supply and claimable amounts are read from the chain, not from this file.
- Both contracts are source-verified (Sourcify exact match, BscScan) but carry no
  third-party audit. Do not describe them as audited.
- `claim()` reverts with NothingToClaim() when nothing is claimable; a reverted
  claim still costs gas.
